messages.subject: propensity score methods with SEM in lavaan
parts:
Dear lavaan users:

Hello all,
Can I use propensity score methods (especially, stratification or weighting) with SEM in lavaan? If it is available, can I get some information or/and an example R code?
Thank you so much for your comprehensive response/comments/suggestions/advice in advance.
Sincerely,
Yonghwan Chang

messages.author: 022bdb23a51c8bdf
messages.subject: Re: propensity score methods with SEM in lavaan
parts:
Dear Yonghwan Chang,
you can use lavaan.survey by Daniel Oberski, if you want to use sampling
weights and take nested sampling (strata) into account. You can find an
example in the help file.
HTH,
Rene
